data.one_liner: Predictable state container for Dart and Flutter using Redux pattern.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Store, reducers, and middleware to manage immutable app state in a unidirectional data flow. Works with any Dart code and can be combined with Flutter via flutter_redux.
use_when: You need a single source of truth with explicit state transitions
You want time‑travel debugging or easy state persistence
Your app benefits from middleware for logging, async, or side‑effects
avoid_when: You prefer a more lightweight solution like Provider
You need built‑in dependency injection or code‑generated models
strengths: Supports middleware, dev tools, and time‑travel debugging
weaknesses: More boilerplate than simple state solutions
No built‑in DI or code generation
data.setup_notes: Add redux to pubspec, then create Store, reducers, and optionally use flutter_redux for UI binding

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers similar unidirectional flow with built‑in event/state separation and less boilerplate

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler API for small apps, integrates directly with Flutter widget tree

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Modern, compile‑time safety and flexible provider system without boilerplate
